title: Alaska Real Estate Salesperson Prelicense Education

_completion_rules_notes.outline_prescribed_by_regulator: 12 AAC 64.063(c) states the eight topics and their contact hours for a course qualifying an applicant for an initial licence. The module map transcribes it; it does not propose an allocation.
_completion_rules_notes.sections_equal_contact_hours: StateCourse design commitment, not an Alaska rule. One instructional section per contact hour so a reviewer counting sections is counting hours.
_completion_rules_notes.attendance_must_be_total: 12 AAC 64.410(a)(6) requires students to be held to a strict attendance policy whether in a classroom or attending a virtual course. For a correspondence course the platform's equivalent is completion evidence, and credit is all-or-nothing per module.
_completion_rules_notes.instructor_graded_instrument_required: 12 AAC 64.430(b) requires a correspondence course to include an unanswered examination, or a project activity, to be turned in to the instructor for grading upon completion of the course, submitted to the Commission for prior approval with the course material. Machine-scored module assessments do not satisfy this rule and no StateCourse document may say they do.
_completion_rules_notes.certificate_requires_course_approval_num: 12 AAC 64.410(a)(9) makes the course approval number one of the certificate's required fields, so no certificate can issue before the Commission assigns one.
_completion_rules_notes.final_exam_required_by_state: Alaska prescribes no proctored final examination for a prelicense course. What 12 AAC 64.430(b) requires is an instructor-graded end-of-course instrument, which is a different thing and is recorded here as its own field. California's final-examination and proctor rules are not imported.
_completion_rules_notes.proctoring_required_by_state: No Alaska rule requires supervised examination for a correspondence prelicense course.
_completion_rules_notes.student_record_retention_years: AS 08.88.351 imposes three-year retention on brokers' transaction records. The Commission's education records requirements are separate and are answered in the submission package; this field records the brokerage-side figure taught in the course.

source_control_note: AS 08.88 and 12 AAC 64 text taken from the Real Estate Commission's published statutes and regulations compilation; AS 09.25, AS 09.35, AS 09.45, AS 18.56, AS 18.80, AS 34.03, AS 34.08, AS 34.20 and AS 34.70 taken from the Alaska Legislature's statute service. Third-party summaries were not relied on.
configuration_scope: Alaska only; no setting is inherited by another state.
